reference_boundary: OpenAI/Codex source docs are citation metadata and governance references only. This manifest promotes platform-neutral ADK skill reproducibility contracts and must not enable Codex skill installs, hosted skill APIs, user-directory writes, or compatibility defaults.

must_not: fix routing by duplicating the whole skill body into system prompts
hide gotchas outside SKILL.md when they affect triggering
use broad descriptions that compete with adjacent skills

pinning_policy.production: pin explicit skill version and compatible runtime/model assumption
pinning_policy.development: latest is allowed only with freshness review and rollback plan
pinning_policy.handoff: record version in generated catalog or manifest

must_not: ship production workflows that depend on whatever latest means
change skill version and model/runtime assumption without validation
overwrite an installed skill without rollback evidence

invocation_policy.override_policy: overrides must reference registered skills and include positive/negative routing evidence
invocation_policy.permission_boundary: invocation controls discovery only and never grants tool, network, write, delegation, commit, publish or install permission

codex.implicit: use nested interface metadata and omit policy

target_mappings.unsupported: fail closed; do not silently downgrade explicit-only to implicit

must_not: infer invocation mode from the skill name or broad description
treat explicit invocation as approval for tools or writes
emit top-level Codex display_name or short_description
emit allow_implicit_invocation true instead of relying on the official default
silently map an unsupported explicit-only mode to implicit

execution_policy.stdout: machine-consumed output must be deterministic or schema-backed
execution_policy.errors: fail loudly with usage or actionable diagnostics
execution_policy.network: network access requires allowlist, data-egress rule and approval boundary

must_not: silently write outputs to unknown paths
swallow command failures and report success
combine open network access with skills without explicit allowlists

trust_policy.global_directories: install state only, not source of truth
trust_policy.promotion: requires supply-chain review, version pin, attribution and rollback

must_not: vendor third-party skill code without license and attribution evidence
treat global user skill directories as project source of truth
promote external skills into default profiles without runtime-boundary review

directory_contract.support_files: optional and loaded only when referenced by the task
directory_contract.progressive_disclosure: metadata first, instructions on trigger, support files on demand

field_constraints.name: 1-64 lowercase alphanumeric or hyphen characters; no leading, trailing or consecutive hyphen; matches parent directory
field_constraints.description: 1-1024 characters and states both capability and trigger context
field_constraints.skill_md: YAML frontmatter followed by Markdown instructions
field_constraints.support_files: scripts, references and assets are optional and referenced with relative paths

compatibility_policy.generated_targets: must preserve name and description and pass target-specific conformance
compatibility_policy.runtime_claim: static conformance is not runtime certification

must_not: rebuild target rendering when the existing compiler already preserves the portable fields
load every support file into context by default
claim Agent Skills compliance from filename presence alone
replace richer ADK metadata with the portable minimum
duplicate full skill procedures in global prompts
promote unversioned skills into production defaults
treat nondeterministic stdout as a stable integration contract
